notes: Work order C1: convergence criterion swapped from peak-to-peak spread to a plateau on the trailing window MEAN of the report's exit-plane thrust, sampled at fixed physical-time intervals (window = 0.5 domain transit L/(|u|+a)_ref = 6.815 nondim, 16 samples/window, fire when the window mean moves < tol/2 = 1e-2 relative from the previous window's mean). Demo case, this machine: trailing-mean fires at step 4461 (t 34.08); the peak-to-peak design on the same signal, window, clock and tol/2 threshold budget fires at step 6247 — 1.40x on steps for zero solver work. The residual criterion (< 1e-3) never fires: minimum over this run 3.98e-1 at step 6247 of 6247 — still hundreds of times the threshold when both other criteria had already fired — which is why it gated the report into a permanent Confidence::NotConverged on the default case and had to go. The residual remains a reported diagnostic in StepInfo.

Signal survey for the plateau monitor, demo case, window 6.815 (16 samples): window-to-window relative drift of the trailing mean per candidate signal — [step 1736 t 13.6: mom 4.79e-1 thrust 1.40e-2 mdot 8.15e-3; step 2613 t 20.4: mom 3.33e-1 thrust 1.90e-2 mdot 4.49e-2; step 3521 t 27.3: mom 2.10e-1 thrust 1.10e-2 mdot 1.67e-4; step 4461 t 34.1: mom 1.45e-1 thrust 5.62e-3 mdot 1.68e-2; step 5410 t 40.9: mom 9.81e-2 thrust 1.11e-3 mdot 1.01e-2; step 6368 t 47.7: mom 5.37e-2 thrust 7.71e-3 mdot 4.03e-3; step 7289 t 54.5: mom 3.05e-2 thrust 2.89e-3 mdot 3.85e-3]. Read: the momentum integral is still drifting at the end (it tracks full acoustic equilibration of the far field, not the report); lip mass flow shows isolated dips below thresholds its later windows re-cross (lucky-dip risk); thrust decays into a stable breathing band, which is what CONVERGED_TOL/2 sits just above.
